title: Bigin creates a new contact on every API create, even for a duplicate email
symptoms: Two or more contacts share one email
Each imported row created its own contact and deal
cause: The create endpoint does not deduplicate contacts by email.
fix: Search by email before creating, and update the existing contact when one is found.
apply: GET /bigin/v2/Contacts/search?email=<email>; create only when the response is 204
affected: Bigin API v2 and Make createAcontact, July 2026
